description: Use when the question is about internal linking, using the site's latest crawl snapshot. Set view: page (inlinks and outlinks for one page; pass url), anchor (which pages use an anchor text and where it points; pass anchor, optional limit). Without a crawl snapshot this returns status=ok with na and nextActions (run_audit) instead of a tool error. For the full cross-source page picture prefer get_evidence.

anchor.description: Anchor text to search for (case-insensitive substring; exact matches rank first). Omit to list the most used anchors.

url.description: Page URL or path on the site's domain

view.description: Which read to run; see the tool description for each view.

name: get_links
title: Read internal links from the latest crawl
